status: Corrected 1.5 source RPM prepared; focused non-root wrapper validation passed four cases. Parent manages ARM64 COPR submission.
method: Actual Fedora xvfb-run and GTK3 display initialization under UID65534 with a root-owned mode0600 file inherited as stderr. The descriptor is writable while reopening /dev/stderr fails. No product code rebuilt or biometric operation performed.
harness_source: phosh.spec %check runtime section; only Meson command replaced with validation probe
failure_evidence: xvfb-run could not reopen /dev/stderr under mockbuild, before the Meson tests started.
change: Xvfb writes a regular file within its private runtime directory. EXIT captures the command status, prints that file using inherited fd2, removes the runtime directory, and returns the original status.

preservation.source_rpm_comparison: Only phosh.spec differs from 1.4; all archives, both code patches, the test suite and the 252-byte PAM source are unchanged.
